command:
set -euo pipefail
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/go-eye-regression3.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch chatgpt-work/avatar-eye-identity-canonical-mask-20260912 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity.git "$TMP/repo"
OUT=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/.go_evidence/eye_semantic_shadow5
if [ -e "$OUT" ]; then echo "FAIL_EXISTING_OUT=$OUT"; exit 3; fi
mkdir -p "$OUT"
BEFORE=$(sha256sum visual/buehne.html | awk '{print $1}')
python3 "$TMP/repo/research_entity/avatar_eye_identity/build_semantic_shadow_html.py" --source visual/buehne.html --visual-root visual --out "$OUT/buehne.shadow.html" | tee "$OUT/manifest.json"
AFTER=$(sha256sum visual/buehne.html | awk '{print $1}')
test "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
o=Path('/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/.go_evidence/eye_semantic_shadow5'); p=o/'buehne.shadow.html'; m=json.loads((o/'manifest.json').read_text())
assert m['schema']=='GO_AVATAR_EYE_SEMANTIC_SHADOW/v4',m['schema']; assert all(m['invariants'].values()),m['invariants']; assert m['live_mutation'] is False
print('EYE_SHADOW_V4_PASS',json.dumps({'source_sha256':m['source_sha256'],'candidate_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'invariants':m['invariants']},sort_keys=True))
PY
sha256sum "$OUT/buehne.shadow.html" "$OUT/manifest.json" visual/buehne.html
